name: noctcore/nightcore
headline: Nothing merges on trust.
subline: Agents plan, build and verify under a policy you set.
alt: noctcore/nightcore. Nothing merges on trust. Agents plan, build and verify under a policy you set.
description: Work built in an isolated worktree passes the guardrail battery, the Structure-Lock gate and an independent reviewer agent before it reaches your branch. A skipped test stops at the guardrails, a cross-layer import stops at the Structure-Lock, and a FAIL verdict stops at the reviewer.
